name: io.github.tonyyang0504/ankorstore-mcp
description: Ankorstore (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order, track. Every tool maps

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ANKORSTORE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id of an application created under Account > Integrations (https://ankorstore.com/account/integrations) of an Ankorstore BRAND account; exchanged at POST https://www.ankorstore.com/oauth/token (grant_type=client_credentials, scope=*) for a 1-hour bearer token that is renewed automatically.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ANKORSTORE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: client_secret of that application (sent in the form body of the token request).
